cli.title: CLI recipes
cli.instructions: Use the CADara CLI: `{BIN}/cadara document recipe [--output compact] <recipe.json>` (also `--help`, `--schema [operation]`). Read CLI_SKILL.md for recipe execution and SDK_SKILL.md's Design intent for modelling guidance. Each invocation is a fresh process with its own private document; only files you save persist between invocations. The CLI is already built; use the command above in place of `bun <cli>/main.js`.

sdk.title: SDK script per process
sdk.instructions: Use the CADara SDK. Read SDK.md first, then SDK_SKILL.md's Design intent for modelling guidance (its workflow targets the shipped SDK, not this prototype). Run a script with `{BIN}/cadara-sdk run <script.ts>`. Each run is a fresh process with a fresh document (open a saved file to continue from it). `{BIN}/cadara document recipe --schema <operation>` prints an operation's exact shape.

rt.title: Persistent runtime
rt.instructions: Use the persistent CADara runtime. Read SDK.md and RUNTIME.md first, then SDK_SKILL.md's Design intent for modelling guidance (its workflow targets the shipped SDK, not this prototype). `{BIN}/cadara-rt start` once; then `{BIN}/cadara-rt run <script.ts>` runs scripts against the SAME open document, which persists between runs until `{BIN}/cadara-rt stop`. `{BIN}/cadara document recipe --schema <operation>` prints an operation's exact shape. Stop the runtime when you are done.

rtlook.title: Persistent runtime + rendered views
rtlook.instructions: Use the persistent CADara runtime. Read SDK.md, RUNTIME.md and LOOK.md first, then SDK_SKILL.md's Design intent for modelling guidance (its workflow targets the shipped SDK, not this prototype). `{BIN}/cadara-rt start` once; then `{BIN}/cadara-rt run <script.ts>` runs scripts against the SAME open document, which persists between runs until `{BIN}/cadara-rt stop`. `{BIN}/cadara-rt look` renders the current model to a PNG you can view with your file-read tool. `{BIN}/cadara document recipe --schema <operation>` prints an operation's exact shape. Stop the runtime when you are done.

sdk-shipped.title: Shipped TypeScript SDK (cadara-kkl.15)
sdk-shipped.instructions: Use the shipped CADara SDK in cadara-cli/sdk. Read SDK.md and SDK_SKILL.md first for modelling; consult CLI_SKILL.md for recipe replay and envelopes. Default-export async (doc) => value; run `{BIN}/cadara script <script.ts> --trace <trace.json>`. Each invocation owns a fresh isolated document. Use live owner-scoped references and the SDK probe to verify parametric edits before saving. The existing sdk/rt/rtlook arms refer to historical prototypes, not this shipped arm.
